run_text_to_sql_chat: run the interactive CLI tool that converts natural language questions into SQL queries using Groq LLM
chat_with_groq_llm: send a prompt to the Groq API and retrieve the AI response with optional JSON mode
execute_duckdb_query: execute a SQL query against an in-memory DuckDB database and return results as a DataFrame
summarize_query_results: generate a natural language summary of DataFrame results based on the original user question
review_chat_with_groq: review the chat_with_groq function to understand how it sends prompts and retrieves responses from the Groq API
